answer: Staked peer review with spot checks. A reviewer puts up a small bond per grade. Spot checks re-grade a random five percent. A wrong grade burns the bond. Rewards vest over future work, so a bought panel gains nothing today. A crystal-clear answer still gets checked. On a knoll of identical clones the pulse of the review pool looks flat, and that flatness is the alarm. Who audits the auditor when the auditor is also a clone?
